newsitem.title: JAPAN: Time needed to confirm full Japan recovery - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Time needed to confirm full Japan recovery - EPA.

text.p: The Japanese government needs more time to determine if the economy is back on a self-sustainable recovery track, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Vice Minister Shimpei Nukaya said on Friday.
Commenting on market talk that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) may tighten its credit policy, Nukaya said he does not think the BOJ has altered its stance on monetary policy.
"The economy is getting better, but more time is needed to conclude that it is back on a self-sustainable recovery path," he told a news conference.
